newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Jan-Apr fishmeal exports up 28.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Jan-Apr fishmeal exports up 28.1 percent.

text.p: Peru exported US$372.2 million worth of fishmeal in the first four months of 1997, up 28.1 percent from the same period last year, preliminary figures released by the Fisheries Ministry showed Tuesday.

Total fishing exports were $458.0 million in the January-April period, up 24.0 percent from the same period last year, the ministry said in an advance report that partly outlined the fishing sector's production in April.
The ministry was due to publish a more detailed report next week.
Exports of Peru's second most important fishing product, raw fish oil, rose to $26.6 million in the first four months, up 64.3 percent compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
The total catch of Peruvian fish and sea species in January-April was 3.35 million tonnes, up from 3.20 million tonnes.
